description: Floor surfaces by name. material = the floor material byte of the map collision (maps/areas/*.glb); the name is what character footstep tables (chara/<Name>/character.json "footsteps"), map place rules (maps/<map>/footsteps.json) and the on_footstep hook (e.surface) see. walk_pitch / run_pitch = the pitch jitter of a walking / running step on it: base + rand % range. A material not listed here uses the "fallback" surface. found_in (how many collision planes and round obstacles of each area use it) and why (how the name was chosen) are notes; the engine reads only material, the name and the pitches. A mod merges its world/surfaces.json by name (a new name needs a material).

default.why: the original's default floor type; every area; concrete step sound

concrete.why: the original plays the concrete step sound on it; the main floor of streets, corridors and rooms everywhere

planks.why: no collision uses it; its sound (footstep_planks, a long hollow knock of the old town bank) is the one the old town plays on the wooden spot of map2_s00 (place rule there)

grass.why: the original's grass floor type and grass step sound; lawns and the snowy ground off the town roads, school yard, resort

gravel.why: town only; its sound is a short bright crunch (footstep_gravel); the name is a best guess

metal_mesh.why: the otherworld town only; the narrow pitch jitter of the metal surfaces; bright noisy sound of the otherworld town bank (footstep_metal_mesh); the name is a best guess

metal.why: the original plays the metal step sound on it; stairs, lids, plates

sewer_floor.why: the original plays the concrete step sound on it; the sewers (and a few resort spots); the Hanged Scratcher, a sewer enemy, treats it specially

wood.why: school floors, house interiors, the town's poles; low hollow thud (footstep_wood)

carpet.why: interiors (ER) mostly; a short muffled step (footstep_carpet); the name is a best guess

metal_plate.why: the original plays the metal step sound on it; metal in the otherworld and the sewers

metal_grating.why: the original plays the metal step sound on it; the otherworld's grating floors (most of it is otherworld); the Hanged Scratcher steps on it with its metal sound, Monster Cybil always steps on it

none.why: the original's floor type for no ground: no ground (holes, the edge of the world); a step there sounds like concrete
